scope_note: Corrected recovery of the article generic and quantified main results under explicit interfaces: all 127 almost simple groups of order at most one million, 10,694 subgroup-class rows, and seven larger applications with 5,294 rows. The 107-page volume includes a seven-page synthesis and 41 complete prior texts. The A11 label correction and every unpaid companion-table obligation remain explicit. This is not complete verification of the named historical or current atlas, its stronger socle-order bound, or all attributed sporadic outputs. Source algorithms, classification and software inputs remain attributed. No compression, measurement, conjecture, principal-refutation or Lean credit.
